atoms.exact_source_text: Each Citizen has one Tool slot.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Citizen has one Tool slot.

atoms.exact_source_text: Physical form remains species-specific, material-specific, and provenance-specific.
atoms.normalized_claim: Physical form remains species-specific, material-specific, and provenance-specific.

atoms.exact_source_text: Different objects are not separate Tool classes unless their function genuinely differs.
atoms.normalized_claim: Different objects are not separate Tool classes unless their function genuinely differs.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Tool appears only after the player chooses an Approach it can credibly affect.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Tool appears only after the player chooses an Approach it can credibly affect.

atoms.exact_source_text: One Tool-derived mechanical advantage may apply to a Turn.
atoms.normalized_claim: One Tool-derived mechanical advantage may apply to a Turn.

atoms.exact_source_text: Selecting the Tool places its holder in Focus for that Turn.
atoms.normalized_claim: Selecting the Tool places its holder in Focus for that Turn.

atoms.exact_source_text: Reach, Cut, Brace, and Render check Strain only after a Tool-supported Approach achieves its intended outcome.
atoms.normalized_claim: Reach, Cut, Brace, and Render check Strain only after a Tool-supported Approach achieves its intended outcome.

atoms.exact_source_text: The current baseline is 90% Holds and 10% Damaged
atoms.normalized_claim: The current baseline is 90% Holds and 10% Damaged.

atoms.exact_source_text: this percentage remains subject to tuning.
atoms.normalized_claim: This percentage remains subject to tuning.

atoms.exact_source_text: Damage occurs after the full benefit and never retracts the achieved outcome.
atoms.normalized_claim: Damage occurs after the full benefit and never retracts the achieved outcome.

atoms.exact_source_text: A damaged Tool is unavailable for the rest of the expedition, then automatically unequips and repairs during early DWELL after Homecoming.
atoms.normalized_claim: A damaged Tool is unavailable for the rest of the expedition, then automatically unequips and repairs during early DWELL after Homecoming.

atoms.exact_source_text: Outposts may repair Tools during Stopover.
atoms.normalized_claim: Outposts may repair Tools during Stopover.

atoms.exact_source_text: Carry functions passively and does not check Strain.
atoms.normalized_claim: Carry functions passively and does not check Strain.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supplies are anonymous prepared units rather than named personal possessions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supplies are anonymous prepared units rather than named personal possessions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each participating Citizen has one Supply slot.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each participating Citizen has one Supply slot.

atoms.exact_source_text: A relevant Supply appears as an inline synergy on a valid Approach.
atoms.normalized_claim: A relevant Supply appears as an inline synergy on a valid Approach.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player chooses whether to spend it
atoms.normalized_claim: The player chooses whether to spend the Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: the interface states the contextual effect and consumption.
atoms.normalized_claim: The interface states the contextual effect and consumption.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Turn permits one active personal-item intervention: one Tool or one Supply.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Turn permits one active personal-item intervention: one Tool or one Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Supply is normally stronger than a reusable Tool but never guarantees success.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply is normally stronger than a reusable Tool but never guarantees success.

atoms.exact_source_text: An unspent Supply returns to the Colony prepared-Supply pool at Homecoming.
atoms.normalized_claim: An unspent Supply returns to the Colony prepared-Supply pool at Homecoming.

atoms.exact_source_text: RENDER makes a Supply.
atoms.normalized_claim: RENDER makes a Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: RENDER is a Node-authored process that consumes suitable material to create one specified Supply.
atoms.normalized_claim: RENDER is a Node-authored process that consumes suitable material to create one specified Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Node determines whether RENDER is available, which Supply is produced, what material is consumed, and what risk or consequence accompanies the process.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Node determines whether RENDER is available, which Supply is produced, what material is consumed, and what risk or consequence accompanies the process.

atoms.exact_source_text: The created Supply may enter any present and capable Citizen’s empty or already-spent Supply slot.
atoms.normalized_claim: The created Supply may enter any present and capable Citizen's empty or already-spent Supply slot.

atoms.exact_source_text: It cannot displace an unspent Supply.
atoms.normalized_claim: The created Supply cannot displace an unspent Supply.
